authority: Operator decision returned in plans/fieldwise_operator_input_pack.md item 9, folded into Tier 3 by plans/fieldwise_tickets.md ticket 6. Recorded per CLAUDE.md §9.4; declared per §13.3; budget handled per §8.1 (deterministic unit-cost derivation) and §8.4.
decision: None of the three optional unit-cost lines applies. Family allowance and long-term leave allowance are operator-declared Assumed; special-needs allowance likewise. The derivation runs on 30 confirmed months at the Hungary coefficient.
why: All three lines are marked 'if applicable' or situational in the Tier 2B rate table. Family circumstances are established at recruitment, not at proposal stage, and leave or special-needs events cannot be foreseen. gate_09_budget_consistency predicate g08_uc03 requires every budget component to resolve to Confirmed or to an operator-declared Assumed value, and it accepts a declaration rather than certainty. A declared assumption is exactly what §13.3 asks for in place of a guess or a blank.

contradiction_resolved.what: The form read 'family_allowance: applies unknown at proposal stage' — two answers at once, and an unknown cannot resolve the predicate.
contradiction_resolved.resolution: The operator declared both remaining lines 'does not apply' as Assumed on 2026-08-11. All three components now resolve: duration Confirmed at 30, family allowance and long-term leave operator-declared Assumed, special needs not applicable.

duration_declaration_deliberately_omitte.what: Item 9 asked for a project_duration_months declaration in working_assumptions.json alongside the two allowance declarations.
duration_declaration_deliberately_omitte.not_done: The duration is Confirmed at 30 in call_binding/selected_call.json, which is where runner/unit_cost_budget.py resolves it first (_resolve_confirmed_months) and where phase_04_gate's timeline_within_duration reads it by name. The shared reader stamps every declaration Assumed, so declaring the duration here would render an operator-Confirmed fact as Assumed in the declared surface and in the canonical reference pack, contradicting the call binding inside one tier (§12.3). The declaration would also be inert, because the call binding wins the precedence order.
duration_declaration_deliberately_omitte.substance_kept: The duration, its composition and its basis are recorded in the call binding, in confirmation_checklist.json under DURATION, and in this decision-log set. Nothing item 9 asked to be recorded is lost; only its location changes. The same reasoning applies to host_country, which is Confirmed as HU in the call binding.

derivation_expected_at_phase_7.note: Recorded for comparison, not as a budget figure this repository computes here. The deterministic deriver owns the arithmetic (§8.1) and Phase 7 writes the artifact.
derivation_expected_at_phase_7.living_allowance: 6350 EUR/month x 78.7% Hungary coefficient x 30 months

engine_gap_dormant: derive_unit_cost_budget never sets include_family (runner/unit_cost_budget.py:159, call at line 507), so an 'applies' answer could not reach the derived artifact without a code change. With the family allowance declared not to apply, nothing needs the flag and the derived total is correct. The engine ticket stays open — the bug is real and would bite on a future run that answers 'applies' — but it no longer blocks this one.
part_a_note: The 2026 Guide for Applicants requires the placement months as a separate line in Part A Section 3. The derived total is a single 30-month block; Part A wants 24 + 6 shown separately. That is a presentation matter, not a change to the total.
gate_effect: gate_09_budget_consistency g08_uc03 can pass once Phase 7 writes the derivation.
